title: File:Downtown Reno, Nevada (17575523693).jpg
author: Ken Lund from Reno, Nevada, USA
description: Reno is a city in the US state of Nevada. Known as "The Biggest Little City in the World", Reno is famous for its casinos and as the birthplace of Caesars Entertainment Corporation. The city is situated in the northwestern part of the state and is the county seat of Washoe County. Reno is the most populous Nevada city outside of the Las Vegas metropolitan area.
